name: ASTRO
recent: Astro 正推进以最高 RM83 million 向 Maxis Broadband 出售其宽带业务资产，并已发出股东通函及召开 EGM 的通知。同期公司公布季度业绩，营收同比下滑且录得净亏损。
notable: MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems 与 Maxis Broadband 签订有条件买卖协议，出售宽带业务资产，现金代价最高 RM83.0 million。
公司将于 2026 年 12 月 3 日召开 EGM，寻求股东批准上述资产出售。
公司发布股东通函，内容有关向 Maxis 出售宽带业务资产。
risks: 公司出现清盘 / 接管人 / 限制令 / 特别管理人相关公告。
季度净亏损 RM25.8 million，净利率 -4.1%。
earnings: 2026 财年截至 7 月 31 日季度营收 RM633.8 million，环比下降 3.9%，同比下降 7.2%；净亏损 RM25.8 million，净利率 -4.1%，上季净利率为 0.2%。

recent_en: Astro is proceeding with the disposal of its broadband business assets to Maxis Broadband for up to RM83 million, having issued a shareholder circular and EGM notice. In the same period, the company reported quarterly results with lower revenue year-on-year and a net loss.
notable_en: MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with Maxis Broadband to dispose of broadband business assets for a cash consideration of up to RM83.0 million.
The company issued a circular to shareholders regarding the disposal of broadband business assets to Maxis.
risks_en: The company made an announcement related to winding up / receiver and manager / restraining order / special administrator.
Quarterly net loss of RM25.8 million with a net margin of -4.1%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM633.8 million, down 3.9% QoQ and 7.2% YoY; net loss was RM25.8 million with a net margin of -4.1%, compared with a net margin of 0.2% in the previous quarter.
